name: El Retorno (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, navy blue and green, the white twice the height and charged with a yellow sun at the upper hoist corner.
history: Municipal flag of El Retorno, a municipality in the department of Guaviare, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: sun in the upper hoist corner
